responsibility: VxWorks crtbegin variant that hooks GNAT EH-frame registration through explicit .ctors/.dtors section entries. After instantiating the shared registration and deregistration functions from vx_crtbegin.inc, it places pointers to them into priority-tagged constructor and destructor sections (using VxWorks user-level priority 101 semantics), so startup code that scans legacy ctor/dtor sections will invoke them. Its distinct responsibility is section-based constructor registration rather than array-based or externally driven invocation.
